an4.39:1.1: Then the brahmin Ujjaya approached the Blessed One and exchanged greetings with him.
an4.39:1.2: When they had concluded their greetings and cordial talk, he sat down to one side and said to the Blessed One:
an4.39:1.4: “I do not praise all sacrifice, brahmin, nor do I withhold praise from all sacrifice.
an4.39:1.6: (1) I do not praise a violent sacrifice at which cattle, goats, rams, chickens, and pigs are slain, at which various creatures are led to slaughter.
an4.39:1.9: Because arahants and those who have entered the path to arahantship do not attend a violent sacrifice.
an4.39:2.1: (3) “But I praise a non-violent sacrifice at which cattle, goats, rams, chickens, and pigs are not slain, where various creatures are not slaughtered,
an4.39:2.2: that is, a regular giving, a sacrifice offered by family custom.
an4.39:2.4: Because arahants and those who have entered the path to arahantship attend a nonviolent sacrifice.”
an4.39:3.3: these grand sacrifices, fraught with violence,
an4.39:4.1: The great seers of right conduct
an4.39:5.1: But when they regularly offer by family custom
an4.39:5.5: That is the sacrifice the great seers
an4.39:6.1: The wise person should offer this;
an4.39:6.3: For one who makes such sacrifice
an4.39:6.4: it is indeed better, never worse.
an4.39:6.5: Such a sacrifice is truly vast
an4.39:6.6: and the deities too are pleased.
